title: Flasque sheaves are acyclic
statement: For a flasque abelian sheaf $F$ on a topological space, $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},F)=0$ for $q>0$, in the resolution sense of [def-sc-zariski-cohomology].

proof.text: Write q = n + 1. Apply the already proved source-library theorem TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.subsingleton_H in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Flasque. Its proof embeds the flasque sheaf into an injective, uses the sectionwise surjectivity and flasque quotient [lem-sc-zariski-flasque-quotient-sections], and dimension shifts. Enough injectives on the opens site follows from [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives]. This realizes the same injective-resolution route as the blueprint.

The representable of the top open is pointwise a singleton. FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv identifies its free abelian presheaf with the constant ULift integer presheaf, naturally since all generators map to 1. Sheafifying and applying Ext.precompAddEquiv identifies H-prime at the top with H. Transport subsingletonness across this equivalence; this is the cohomology of [def-sc-zariski-cohomology].
